body.purpose: Control-bar labels, sub-headers, general card copy.

label.purpose: Uppercase, tracked label used only on status pills and table header cells.

data-cell.purpose: Dominant size across all dense tables (backlog + dashboards).

shadows.name: glass-bar
shadows.purpose: Separation of the sticky dark-glass control bar from page content.

shadows.name: card-ambient
shadows.purpose: Soft ambient lift under every white content card.

shadows.name: brand-glow
shadows.purpose: Tinted glow exclusive to the primary gradient button; intensifies to 0 6px 20px rgba(230,57,70,0.45) on hover.

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: Default transition easing on buttons and inputs.

motion.name: duration-fast
motion.purpose: Hover/focus state transitions across buttons, inputs, pills.

breakpoints.name: sm
breakpoints.purpose: Hides secondary control-bar text (last-updated, auto-refresh note) below this width.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single dominant CTA per screen (e.g. Download CSV).
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { height: 40px; background: linear-gradient(135deg, #ff4d5a, #e63946); color: #fff; border: none; padding: 0 20px; font-size: 0.85rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.2px; border-radius: 10px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; box-shadow: 0 4px 15px rgba(230,57,70,0.3); transition: all 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { transform: translateY(-1px); box-shadow: 0 6px 20px rgba(230,57,70,0.45); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #e63946; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; transform: none; }

components.name: Outline Button (Active Toggle)
components.description: Secondary/toggle button used for stage tabs and sign-out; carries an explicit active state.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { height: 40px; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.05); border: 1px solid #4d4d70; color: #ccc; padding: 0 18px; font-size: 0.85rem; font-weight: 500; border-radius: 10px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; transition: all 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.1); border-color: #6d6d90; color: #fff; } .ds-btn-outline[data-active='true'] { background: rgba(230,57,70,0.15); border-color: #e63946; color: #fff; } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #ff7d86; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Status Pill
components.description: Capsule status/count indicator; five color triads (neutral/info/success/error/warning), each dark fill + saturated border + tinted text.
components.css: .ds-pill { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 3px 12px; border-radius: 20px; font-size: 0.68rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.3px; text-transform: uppercase; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-pill-dot { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 50%; margin-right: 6px; background: currentColor; } .ds-pill-success { background: #102e1f; color: #52cc8a; border: 1px solid #27ae60; } .ds-pill-warning { background: #3a2c0f; color: #f0b84d; border: 1px solid #b8860b; } .ds-pill-error { background: #2e1010; color: #cc5252; border: 1px solid #c0392b; } .ds-pill-info { background: #1a3a5c; color: #7ec8f5; border: 1px solid #3498db; } .ds-pill-neutral { background: #23233b; color: #8e99c5; border: 1px solid #3d3d5c; }

components.name: Dark-Glass Control Bar Input
components.description: Select/button-styled control living on the sticky dark-glass bar (company dropdown, dashboard select).
components.css: .ds-input-dark { height: 40px; padding: 0 14px; border-radius: 10px; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1); background: rgba(255,255,255,0.05); color: #fff; font-size: 0.82rem; outline: none; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-input-dark:focus { border-color: #e63946; background: #2a2a45; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(230,57,70,0.15); }

components.name: Content Card
components.description: The system's sole content container: white surface, 16px radius, soft ambient shadow.
components.css: .ds-card { background: #fff; border-radius: 16px; box-shadow: 0 30px 90px rgba(0,0,0,0.12); border: 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.05); overflow: hidden; }

components.name: Dense Data Table
components.description: The system's signature: dark charcoal sticky header, striped rows, red-tinted hover, hairline borders, status pills in the data column.
components.css: .ds-table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; } .ds-table thead th { background: #2c2c2c; color: #fff; text-transform: uppercase; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.3px; font-size: 0.68rem; padding: 10px 12px; border-right: 1px solid #444; text-align: left; } .ds-table td { padding: 8px 12px; font-size: 0.75rem; color: #333; border: 1px solid #e8e8e8; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-table tbody tr:nth-child(even) td { background: #f9f9f9; } .ds-table tbody tr:hover td { background: #fdeceb; }

components.name: Loading Spinner
components.description: Circular loading indicator used during SimPRO fetch waits.
components.css: .ds-spinner { width: 40px; height: 40px; border: 4px solid rgba(26,26,46,0.1); border-top-color: #e63946; border-radius: 50%; animation: ds-spin 0.75s linear infinite; } @keyframes ds-spin { to { transform: rotate(360deg); } }

narrative.overview: AFSS Backlog is a directed restyle onto a sibling internal tool's (FPOWS) established look, not an original creative direction: a dense operational data console housed inside a dark-glass control shell, with content living on white cards over a light-gray ground. The build confirms the pinned world faithfully — sticky dark-navy glass bar, red/crimson brand accent, Inter throughout, striped dark-headed tables, capsule status pills — and adds nothing beyond it. Density is the point: every table in this system (backlog rows, dashboard grids) carries far more columns than fit a viewport comfortably, and the system does not fight that; it manages it with sticky headers, horizontal scroll, and small, consistent type rather than by simplifying the data. The dashboards (dashboard, dashboard2) preserve a pre-existing spreadsheet/report structure (multi-row rowSpan/colSpan grid headers) — this build only reskinned that structure's chrome and color to match FPOWS; the structural density itself is inherited, not a new design decision, and should not be read as a signature grid pattern to imitate on non-tabular surfaces.
keyCharacteristics: Dark-glass sticky control bar as the one fixed chrome element on every authenticated screen (shared via UserBar.tsx plus each page's own control bar).
Brand red/crimson reserved for primary actions, focus rings, and small brand marks — never for body text or large fills.
White, single-radius cards as the only content container; no secondary container styles.
Capsule pills as the sole status/count-encoding device — no badges, no colored underlines, no icon-only status marks.
Dense tables are a first-class citizen: small type, tight padding, sticky headers, striped rows, no attempt to air out the data.

rules.name: The Red-Is-Rare Rule
rules.body: Brand red/crimson appears only on: the primary CTA, focus rings, active-toggle borders, small identifying swatches, and the spinner. It never fills a card, a table, or body text — its rarity against the navy glass and white cards is what keeps it legible as the action color.

rules.name: The One-Family Rule
rules.body: There is no second (display/serif/mono) typeface anywhere in the shipped build. Every weight from 300–800 is Inter; new surfaces should not introduce a display face.

rules.name: The Soft-Glow-Only Rule
rules.body: Every shadow in the shipped build is large-radius and diffuse (ambient card lift, glass-bar blur, tinted button glow). Don't introduce hard-offset/neobrutalist shadows — that vocabulary doesn't exist anywhere in this build.

dos: Do keep brand red/crimson confined to primary actions, focus states, and small identity marks (The Red-Is-Rare Rule).
Do use the 10px control radius for every interactive control and the 16px card radius for every content container — no third radius scale.
Do render status/state exclusively as capsule pills with a dark-fill + colored-border + colored-text triad, never a solid saturated fill.
Do keep dashboard STATUS_ROWS and per-job status-pill colors as data-driven semantic encoding — preserve their meaning if the dashboard is extended, don't restyle them decoratively.
Do use soft, large-radius ambient shadows and glass blur for depth; keep the tinted glow shadow exclusive to the primary/gradient button.
donts: Don't introduce hard-offset/neobrutalist shadows — no shadow in this build has a small, non-blurred offset.
Don't add a second typeface; Inter (300–800) is the only family used across the whole build.
Don't invent a new badge/chip shape for status or counts — the capsule pill is the system's only device for that job.

Don't treat the dashboard's inherited rowSpan/colSpan report-grid density as a pattern to imitate on new, non-tabular surfaces — it's a preserved structural artifact of the pre-existing dashboards, not a chosen signature layout.
